tasks.text: Full Visualsoft backup: product exports for both sites, live SEO for 4,863 pages and 1,690 product photos
Domain check: both domains are registered at IONOS; DNS is hosted by Visualsoft; email runs on IONOS
Product Keep List built for the client to review every product
New website built from the approved design on GitHub + Vercel, with all 1,057 products
Shop and product pages matched to the original design; 848 photos turned into cut-outs
Room Studio 3D planner added at /studio, with a homepage section
Confirm both domains are in the client’s own IONOS account
tasks.detail: Log in to IONOS and check artificialplants.co.uk and replicaplants.co.uk are listed. If not, ask Visualsoft who holds the login.

tasks.text: Decide the primary domain and brand for the new store
tasks.detail: One of artificialplants.co.uk, replicaplants.co.uk or replicalandscapes.co.uk (not yet owned). Decide what the other domains do: redirect to the new store, or stay as a second shop.

tasks.text: Check the Visualsoft contract: notice period, end date, exit fees
Ask Visualsoft in writing for the DNS zone files, customer and order export, newsletter list and reviews export
tasks.detail: Use the email draft. Keep the reply as proof of data handover.

tasks.text: Copy DNS from Visualsoft to IONOS record for record, then switch nameservers
tasks.detail: Nothing visible changes. Test email sending and receiving straight after.

tasks.text: Client finishes the Product Keep List
tasks.detail: Every product marked Keep, Maybe or Remove. Maybes resolved by the end of the week.

tasks.text: Open the Shopify store in the client’s name and add staff accounts
tasks.detail: Plan: Shopify (Basic is enough to start). The client should be the store owner, not the agency.

tasks.text: Choose payment methods: Shopify Payments, PayPal, Apple Pay and Google Pay
tasks.detail: Needs company details, bank account and VAT number.

tasks.text: Store a second copy of the Visualsoft backup (Google Drive or external drive)
Turn on two-factor sign-in for Vercel, GitHub, IONOS and Shopify
tasks.detail: Vercel is already showing this prompt.

weeks.title: Week 2
weeks.note: Black Friday is Fri 27 Nov. The old site keeps trading; no changes to it this week except stock and prices.

tasks.text: Build the Shopify import file from the kept products only
tasks.detail: Products, size options, prices, descriptions, tags, SEO titles and photos in order.

tasks.text: Import products and photos into Shopify and spot-check 30 products
Create Shopify collections matching the website’s categories and sub-categories
Set shipping zones and rates, including large trees, Highlands & islands and Northern Ireland
tasks.detail: Client decides prices; agency sets them up. Visualsoft’s courier rules are in the export.

tasks.text: Set VAT: prices include 20% VAT; add the VAT number to invoices
Connect Shopify to the website so basket and checkout work on the preview
tasks.detail: Two settings in Vercel: store domain and Storefront access token.

tasks.text: Move gift vouchers to Shopify gift cards and honour unspent Visualsoft vouchers
tasks.detail: Get a list of live voucher codes and balances from Visualsoft.

tasks.text: Import customers (passwords can’t move) and prepare the account invitation email
tasks.detail: Only customers who can lawfully be contacted receive marketing.

tasks.text: Freeze new products on Visualsoft from Wed 25 Nov
tasks.detail: Anything added after this date must be added to Shopify too.

tasks.text: Clean product descriptions: remove “Click here…” leftovers and merge summaries
Write the missing meta titles and descriptions (about 30 products)
Replace weak photos; reshoot key products on plain white if possible
Legal pages: Terms, Privacy, Cookies, Delivery, Returns; company number and registered office in the footer
tasks.detail: UK sites must show the company’s legal name, number and registered office.

tasks.text: Cookie consent banner with Google Consent Mode
tasks.detail: Needed before analytics or ad tracking runs.

tasks.text: 301 redirect map: every old product, category and page URL on both domains to its new page
tasks.detail: Built from the SEO crawl (4,863 URLs). Protects Google rankings.

tasks.text: Analytics and Google: GA4, Search Console, Merchant Center product feed, Meta pixel
Brand the order and shipping emails; add SPF, DKIM and DMARC so they don’t land in spam
Move the newsletter list to Shopify Email or Klaviyo with consent records
tasks.detail: Mailjet is currently set up on the domain.

tasks.text: Make the contact and bespoke enquiry forms deliver to the sales inbox
Test 10 real orders: card, PayPal, discount code, gift card, refund
Test on phones and tablets; check page speed and accessibility
Client reviews the preview site and signs off
Final export from Visualsoft: new orders, stock and price changes since the import
Go live: point the domain at the new website and Shopify checkout; check SSL
Switch on the redirects and test 50 old URLs
Allow Google to index the site and submit the sitemap
Place a live order and check every email arrives
Send customers the “new website” and password-reset email
Daily checks: broken links (404s), orders, payments, Search Console
tasks.detail: Every day until 8 Jan.

tasks.text: Handover meeting and Shopify training for the client team

weeks.title: After launch
weeks.theme: Settle in, then switch off Visualsoft

tasks.text: 30 days of monitoring: rankings, sales, errors
Keep the Visualsoft account (not the website) until all data is confirmed
Give Visualsoft notice once the new site has run cleanly for 30 days
Cancel services tied to Visualsoft: Mailjet, payment links, feeds
Review: what to improve in January (photos, Room Studio links to products, reviews)
Shopify store owner is the client
Vercel project moved to the client’s own Vercel team on the Pro plan
tasks.detail: Vercel’s free Hobby plan is for personal, non-commercial use. A shop needs Pro.

tasks.text: GitHub repository owned by the client, with the agency as collaborator
IONOS domains in the client’s account, set to auto-renew (renewals Mar 2027 and Oct 2027)
Google Analytics, Search Console and Merchant Center owned by a client email address
Payment providers (Shopify Payments, PayPal) in the company’s name
All logins shared through a password manager; two-factor recovery codes stored safely
Every DNS record documented (website, checkout, email, verifications)
Email sending and receiving tested on every mailbox after the switch
SPF, DKIM and DMARC records in place
Secondary domains redirect to the primary domain
Product count in Shopify matches the Keep List
Collections, shipping rates, VAT and payments checked by the client
Checkout branded; order, shipping and refund emails branded
Gift cards and discount codes recreated
Store policies (refund, privacy, terms, shipping) filled in Shopify
Every page reviewed on desktop and phone
Forms deliver to the sales inbox
404 page, favicon and social share image set
Room Studio works; fallback image shows where 3D isn’t supported
Page speed and accessibility checked
All 301 redirects live and spot-checked
Sitemap submitted; Search Console shows no errors
Every product has a meta title and description
If the domain changes: old domain kept in Search Console and Change of Address submitted
Google Merchant Center feed approved; Shopping ads re-linked
Customers imported; order history archived for reference
Visualsoft backup stored in two places
Privacy policy names the new processors (Shopify, Vercel, Google)
Cookie banner live and tested
Marketing consent carried across; unsubscribes respected
Client trained: products, stock, orders, refunds, discounts, gift cards
Written guide: how to change website content and who to ask
Support agreement and response times agreed for after launch
Monthly running costs listed: Shopify, Vercel Pro, apps, domains
Final data export received and checked
Notice given in writing; end date confirmed
Integrations and subscriptions tied to Visualsoft cancelled
Final invoice paid; account closed
